bbmp_jxs: engine.h and jxs_engine.cpp from github.com/creep-ltx/bbmp csrc/synth, commit 19d87098b3716156d80224d22dc49ca22884d1b7,
unchanged (GPL-3.0-or-later, SPDX line in each file). JayTrax (.jxs), a clean-room replayer written for bbmp. Built with -fwrapv and
-ffp-contract=off as the engine's header asks. Only the jxs engine of csrc/synth is vendored; the other engines and bbmp-synth.cpp
(the helper main) are not. BBMP_JXS_TODAY is not used by the adapter (default behaviour).
